page.overview:
Who is Yeti Cool Brothers?

The Yeti Cool Brothers are and , a pair of giant assassins who were employed by Caesar Clown. They are members of a mysterious type of giant.

They serve as supporting antagonists of the Punk Hazard Arc.

The brothers are a pair of furry giants, having long limbs and being covered in white fur all over their bodies except their fingers. It is unknown if they are actual yetis, although several characters believe them to be due to the strong parallels.

Their height dwarfs that of many giants. One of the brother's footprints is larger than Brook, who stands at 277 cm (9'1"). When the pair captured Franky under Caesar Clown's orders, Scotch held his entire 240 cm (7'10½") frame in just one hand.
